title: Memento No More: Coaching AI Agents to Master Multiple Tasks via Hints Internalization
abstract: arXiv:2502.01562v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As the general capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) agents continue to evolve, their ability to learn to master multiple complex tasks through experience remains a key challenge. Current LLM agents, particularly those based on proprietary language models, typically rely on prompts to incorporate knowledge about the target tasks. This approach does not allow the agent to internalize this information and instead relies on ever-expanding prompts to sustain its functionality in diverse scenarios. This resembles a system of notes used by a person affected by anterograde amnesia, the inability to form new memories. In this paper, we propose a novel method to train AI agents to incorporate knowledge and skills for multiple tasks without the need for either cumbersome note systems or prior high-quality demonstration data. Our approach employs an iterative process where the agent collects new experiences, receives corrective feedback

translated_title: 告别“记忆碎片”：通过提示内化训练AI智能体掌握多重任务
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能（AI）智能体的通用能力不断提升，它们通过经验学习掌握多个复杂任务的能力仍然是一个关键挑战。当前的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，特别是基于专有语言模型的智能体，通常依赖提示词来纳入关于目标任务的知识。这种方法无法让智能体内化这些信息，而是依赖不断膨胀的提示词来维持其在多样化场景中的功能。这就像一个患有顺行性遗忘症（即无法形成新记忆）的人所使用的笔记系统。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法来训练AI智能体融合多任务的知识和技能，而无需繁琐的笔记系统或预先的高质量示范数据。我们的方法采用迭代过程，智能体在其中收集新经验、接受纠正性反馈（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种通过提示内化训练AI智能体的新方法，使智能体无需依赖不断膨胀的提示词或高质量示范数据，即可通过迭代收集经验与纠正性反馈来内化多任务知识与技能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method to train AI agents to internalize knowledge and skills for multiple tasks through an iterative process of collecting experiences and receiving corrective feedback, eliminating the need for ever-expanding prompts or high-quality demonstration data.
